title: The Quantum Foam
description: Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

puzzle.goal: Empty space is a sea of field modes; each mode of wavenumber k keeps a ground-state energy ½ħω even with no particles present. For a field of mass m, ω depends on k through the relativistic energy relation. Sum the ground-state energies of all modes per unit volume, counting modes in spherical shells of k-space, up to a cutoff wavenumber k_P where spacetime itself stops being smooth.
puzzle.name: Zero-point vacuum energy density (massive field, Planck cutoff)
puzzle.ask: The same fluctuations let a particle-antiparticle pair borrow ΔE = 2mc² for Δt ≈ ħ/(2ΔE) = ħ/(4mc²). Find Δt for an electron pair in zeptoseconds, with ħ = 658.2 keV·zs, m = 511 keV/c² and c = 1.
puzzle.method: Modes per unit volume in a shell are 4πk² dk/(2π)³; each carries ½ħω with ħω = √(ħ²c²k² + m²c⁴).
